title: Practice: a raw Messages API client, graded on the HTTP contract (TypeScript)

cases.id: m1 request has method url three headers and json body
cases.says: The request has the right method, URL, exactly three headers and a JSON body

cases.id: e1 blank or absent system is left out of the body
cases.says: A blank or absent system is left out of the body

cases.id: e2 bad input is refused before anything is sent
cases.says: Bad input is refused before the transport is called

cases.id: e3 success returns the message and text joins text blocks only
cases.says: A good reply is parsed, and text_of joins text blocks only

cases.id: e4 an error reply becomes an api error with the header request id
cases.says: An error reply becomes an ApiError; the header's request id wins over the body's

cases.id: e5 a reply that is not json still gives an api error
cases.says: A reply that is not JSON still gives an ApiError (unknown)

cases.id: e6 the api key never appears in an error
cases.says: The API key never appears in an error
